definitions.explanation: The year after this one; the coming year. Used to refer to future events or plans in the year that follows the current one.

examples.english: I want to go to Japan next year.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}⟦また→また：00969⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→あう：00482⟧。

examples.english: I want to become good at Japanese by next year.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}⟦は→は：00079⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→にほんご：00614⟧⟦が→が：00051⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→じょうず：00707⟧⟦に→に：00314⟧⟦なる→なる：01970⟧⟦ように→ように：10081⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→まいにち：00729⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}します→べんきょうする：00527⟧。
examples.english: I'll study every day next year so that I can become better at Japanese.
I'm thinking of going on an overseas trip with my family next summer. I'm saving money from now.

notes:
{来年|らいねん} means 'next year' and can function as either a noun or an adverb.

TIME SERIES:
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→きょねん：00727⟧/⟦{昨年|さくねん}→さくねん：10433⟧: last year
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→ことし：00722⟧: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year
- ⟦{再来年|さらいねん}→さらいねん：01417⟧: the year after next

THE {来|らい} PREFIX:
Means 'coming/next' and appears in many time words:
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→らいしゅう：00746⟧: next week
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→らいげつ：00744⟧: next month
- {来学期|らいがっき}: next semester

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {来年|らいねん}の⟦{春|はる}→はる：00627⟧: next spring
- {来年|らいねん}から: starting next year
- {来年|らいねん}までに: by next year
- {来年|らいねん}こそ: next year for sure

REGISTER:
⟦{昨年|さくねん}→さくねん：10433⟧ (last year) and {翌年|よくねん} (the following year) are more formal alternatives.
